value.title: Address and discovery contract
value.summary: Canonicalize bare-path whole-file addresses and collect structured/incidental file references through one pure contract.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Implement the grammar and discovery foundation only. Start from contract tests; audit all `parseAddress` references with LSP before changing it. Structured `target: file` cells store repo-relative paths; Markdown links are discovered only inside declared `text` and keep document-relative href semantics. The shared check receives an existence seam and must not read or hash ordinary targets.

value.title: Pin whole-file grammar and compatibility before implementation
value.success: Parser tests prove bare path -> file form with zero segments, canonical round-trip, empty/trailing-# refusal, every old worked example unchanged, and `file#method` still syntax-valid. The property test includes both whole-file and interior forms.
value.notes: Break the parser or formatter and confirm the targeted test names the planted form before restoring.

value.title: Implement canonical bare-path address form and migrate callers
value.success: `parseAddress`, `formatAddress`, normalization, CLI syntax output, and all LSP-discovered callers compile against an explicit file form without changing existing interior results or inventing empty-fragment output.
value.notes: Use LSP references before edits. Keep parseAddress public; do not add an alias or compatibility parser.

value.title: Pin structured and Markdown file-reference populations
value.success: Tests collect one cell per `target: file` value and one per inline Markdown link in `text`, carry `repo` versus `document` path bases, keep authored relation/location, and exclude external URLs, fragments, images, malformed syntax, non-text fields, and bare prose paths.
value.notes: The negative population is part of the contract, not optional edge polish.

value.title: Implement file-cell discovery and pure existence classification
value.success: One core path emits typed file cells for structured and incidental references, resolves their explicit bases safely inside the repository, and returns zero findings for an existing path or exactly one WARN for a missing path through an injected existence probe. No content read/hash/schema load occurs.
value.notes: Reuse existing address path warnings and relation handling. Do not sniff strings outside declared `text` or `target: file`.
